A stopped download can be started again, dragging works, and the colour picker reaches every colour.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **A stopped download no longer occupies a slot for ever.** This one was mine, from earlier the same day. Stopping a download handled by JDownloader used to leave a watcher running; closing it was right, and it quietly took away something the restart path was relying on. A task that was stopped and started again then held one of the three concurrent slots with nothing left to report on it: "running", zero bytes, indefinitely. Two of those were sitting on a live instance while this was being written, blocking everything behind them.
- **Dragging to reorder works.** The list keeps streaming while a finger is down, so the rows were being rebuilt and re-sorted mid-gesture: in a recording of the problem, the top row changes identity between the third and fifth second with the finger still on it. Everything after that is about rows that have moved on, which is why the lifted row lay over the others doing nothing. The list now holds still for as long as a drag is armed, and the drag remembers WHICH row it picked up rather than which position it was in.
- **The colour picker reaches every colour, and keeps the one you chose.** Two separate faults. It read the drag position from whichever square of the grid was under the finger instead of from the field, so saturation never left the first few per cent and only near-white and near-black were reachable. And it never reset when reopened, because the window it lives in is hidden rather than closed, so the second colour you edited started from the first one's value and looked like the edit had jumped.
- **The connect button shakes instead of writing a sentence.** For an empty field, which is the one refusal that has nothing to explain. A phrase with a word that is not on the list still says which word, because that is information worth keeping.

## ✨ Added

- **A reset for both colour rows**, always there rather than appearing once something has changed. A control that is sometimes present is one nobody learns the position of.
- **The About card says what this is.** Written in evenings and weekends, on more coffee than is strictly advisable. There is a button for the coffee now, and the report routes have one each with a glyph of their own.
- **The instance cards carry the logo**, like the browser extension's, and the status is a small badge with the word on it rather than a coloured dot. A dot asks you to know the colour code; to anybody who cannot tell this green from this red it says nothing at all.

## 🎨 Changed

- **The colour swatches fit on one line.** Eight of them plus a reset at a fixed size did not, so the row wrapped; they now divide the space the row has, whatever the phone.
- **The theme and corner selectors follow the rainbow.** Every card around them had gone plural while those two stayed flat gold.

Settings live under **Overview › the gear › Appearance**.
